title: Ranking
intro: Points are computed from contributions, never typed.

empty.title: Nobody has points yet
empty.text: Publish a route, check one or answer a question to open the ranking.

rules.heading: How to earn points
rules.intro: Each contribution counts once; hidden or removed content earns nothing.
rules.trust: From {{count}} points on, you become a confirmed member. You can then write on your blog, your report counts twice and your writing quotas are three times larger. The status follows your points.
